title: Intermezzo
author: Sally Rooney
summary: Two brothers, a lawyer and a young chess player, are left badly shaken after their father’s death. Each starts a relationship that complicates their feelings, and their strained bond becomes the heart of the story.
readIf: you like quiet, interior literary fiction about grief, love and difficult families.
skipIf: you want a plot-driven read, because most of it unfolds in conversation and thought.

pairings.reason: The same author’s earlier novel, with the same attentive focus on how people hurt and love each other.
Another story of grief and connection with a much warmer, more comic tone.
A restrained, reflective novel about regret, feeling and the things people cannot say.
